The result must be a landscape 4-column by 3-row REGULAR GRID ATLAS on a truly TRANSPARENT background, canvas ideally 2048x1536. All 12 equal square cells have independent centered objects, margins, no object crosses into a neighboring cell. No cell outlines, numbers, headings or caption text. Strict orthographic view from directly above, top of phone points UP, neutral studio light, subtle material texture, almost no cast shadow. This is game art, not a photo of a work table.
Cell order, row-major, exactly:
1. The whole OPENED-OUT flat tri-fold phone CHASSIS interior with all three thin panels and two different precision hinges. GOLD perimeter, realistic main PCB ONLY in camera-side LEFT panel upper area, narrow daughterboards in the two other panels, graphite, copper traces, screw holes and gold connectors. 2. The whole fully unfolded EXTERIOR BACK: exactly THREE red leather panels joined by gold hinges, large octagonal gold XMAGE camera housing with three lenses and a rectangular periscope aperture on the upper LEFT panel only, discreet correct HUAWEI mark. No Samsung shape or lettering. 
3. The reverse side of the detached wide flexible INNER DISPLAY assembly: three sections, silver/graphite backing, two fold lines, realistic orange/black flex cable tails, gold FPC plugs. No fingers.
4. The whole fully unfolded FRONT display in its gold perimeter, black powered-OFF glass, slim bezels and correct small selfie punch hole. No wallpaper or UI.
5. One detachable smaller camera-panel silicon-carbon battery, dark pouch with natural silver foil edge, realistic flex connector, NO printed writing or logos.
6. One independent triple-camera/periscope module corresponding to the camera-side cavity. Realistic lens barrels and rectangular periscope, not Samsung's three inline lenses.
7. Independent metal main-board/FPC shield shaped to sit beside the camera in the upper first panel.
8. Independent HUAWEI USB-C charging daughterboard with long black and orange flex and tiny gold contacts.
9. Independent second-panel battery, larger thin black pouch, no text, with connector tail.
10. Independent third-panel battery, larger thin black pouch, no text, with connector tail.
11. Reverse INSIDE of the detached three-panel REAR COVER: realistic graphite liners, adhesive perimeter, an NFC/charging coil on camera panel, NO batteries and no imaginary motherboard.
12. Independent long black hinge interconnect ribbon assembly with gold FPC ends and two articulated folds.
Make every object crisp, correctly proportioned and separated. Chassis and covers have unfolded width:height ~219:156.7, not three identical tall Samsung phones. Batteries are unmarked because exact HUAWEI labels will be drawn by the game. Absolutely NO SAMSUNG text, NO random typography, no watermarks, no hands, no tools, no illustrated mat, no installed battery baked into the chassis, no screen baked into the chassis.
